title: Laravel Kya Hai aur Kaise Kaam Karta Hai
objectives: Laravel kya hai aur framework ki zarurat kyun padti hai samajhna
Plain PHP aur Laravel ka farak dekhna
Browser request ka Laravel mein safar (high level) jaanna
Laravel ecosystem ke main tools pehchanna
Laravel 11, 12, 13 ke support aur PHP requirements jaanna

sections.heading: Laravel kya hai?
sections.body:
Laravel ek **web application framework** hai jiska syntax expressive aur saaf hai. Framework tumhe ek **structure aur starting point** deta hai, taaki tum login, database, email jaise common kaam baar-baar scratch se na likho.

Laravel mein dependency injection, database abstraction layer, queues aur scheduled jobs, aur testing jaise powerful features milte hain.

callout.text: Framework ko ghar ka ready-made structure samjho: neev, deewarein aur wiring pehle se hai. Tum sirf kamre apne hisaab se sajate ho.

sections.heading: Real-world example: Restaurant
sections.body:
Browser (customer) URL maangta hai. **Route** waiter hai jo order lekar sahi jagah bhejta hai. **Controller** kitchen ka head hai. **Model** store-room hai jahan se ingredients (data) aate hain. **View** plate hai jo customer ke saamne aati hai.

Har role alag hai, isliye code organized rehta hai.

sections.heading: Plain PHP vs Laravel
sections.body: Bina framework ke har URL ko `if` se check karna padta hai. Laravel mein ek line ka route kaafi hai.

code.code:
<?php

$path = parse_url($_SERVER['REQUEST_URI'], PHP_URL_PATH);

if ($path === '/products') {
    echo 'Product List';
} elseif ($path === '/about') {
    echo 'About';
} else {
    http_response_code(404);
    echo 'Not found';
}

<?php

use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Route;

Route::get('/products', fn () => 'Product List');
Route::get('/about', fn () => 'About');

explain: Plain PHP mein 404, URL parsing sab khud likhna padta hai.
Laravel mein routing, 404 response, security aur baaki sab framework sambhalta hai.

sections.heading: Request ka safar (high level)
sections.body:
Jab browser `/products` maangta hai, to Laravel mein yeh hota hai:

- Request `public/index.php` se andar aati hai (yeh sab requests ka entry point hai).
- Application boot hoti hai aur router URL ko kisi route se match karta hai.
- Route ka closure ya controller chalta hai (zarurat ho to model se data aata hai).
- Result ek response (HTML ya JSON) ban kar browser ko wapas jaata hai.

Is safar ko detail mein Module 03 (Architecture and MVC) mein padhenge.

sections.heading: Laravel ecosystem
sections.body:
Laravel sirf framework nahi, tools ka poora ecosystem hai. Abhi naam jaan lo, aage ke modules mein har ek ko seekhenge:

- **Artisan** – command line tool
- **Blade** – template engine
- **Eloquent** – database ORM
- **Queues** – background jobs
- **Sanctum / Passport** – API authentication
- **Livewire / Inertia** – modern frontend ke tareeke
- **Vite** – CSS/JS bundling
- **Herd, Sail** – local development environments
- **Laravel Cloud** – hosting platform

versionDiff.heading: Laravel 11, 12 aur 13: support aur PHP
versionDiff.intro: Teeno versions ka core idea same hai. Farak PHP requirement aur support dates mein hai.

items.11: PHP 8.2 se 8.4. March 12, 2024 ko release hua. Security fixes March 12, 2026 ko khatam ho gaye, yani ab yeh legacy hai. Naye project ke liye mat chuno.
items.12: PHP 8.2 se 8.5. February 24, 2025 ko release hua. Bug fixes August 13, 2026 tak the, ab sirf security fixes February 24, 2027 tak milenge.
items.13: PHP 8.3 se 8.5. March 2026 mein release hua. Bug fixes Q3 2027 tak aur security fixes Q1 2028 tak. Naye project ke liye yehi current version hai.

errors.error: Laravel ko subfolder se serve karna (jaise localhost/laravel/public)
errors.cause: Web server ka document root project ka `public` folder nahi hai. Isse `.env` jaisi private files expose ho sakti hain.
errors.fix: Document root hamesha `public` rakho. Local par `php artisan serve` ya Herd use karo.

errors.error: Your PHP version does not satisfy the requirement
errors.cause: Laravel version ki minimum PHP se purana PHP chal raha hai.
errors.fix: `php -v` se check karo. Laravel 11/12 ko 8.2+, Laravel 13 ko 8.3+ chahiye.

errors.error: Class/Interface samajh nahi aa raha (Laravel code confusing lagta hai)
errors.cause: PHP OOP (classes, interfaces, namespaces) ki neev kamzor hai.
errors.fix: Module 01 ke lesson dobara padho, phir yahan wapas aao.

debug.body: Setup shuru karne se pehle apna environment check karo.

tasks: Restaurant example ko apni pasand ke kisi doosre example se likho (jaise library ya hospital)
Plain PHP ke routing code mein ek aur page (`/contact`) jodo, phir socho Laravel mein kitni lines lagengi
Laravel ki official website par Release Notes khol kar 11, 12, 13 ke support dates dekho
`php -v` chalao aur check karo kaunsa Laravel version tumhare PHP par chalega

quiz.why: Laravel PHP ka framework hai. Language PHP hi rehti hai.

quiz.q: Laravel mein sab requests ka entry point kaunsi file hai?
quiz.why: `public/index.php` se request application mein daakhil hoti hai.

quiz.q: Laravel 13 ko minimum kaunsa PHP chahiye?
quiz.why: Laravel 13 PHP 8.3 ya upar maangta hai.

interview.a: Laravel ek open-source PHP web framework hai jo routing, database access, templating, queues, testing jaise features ek structured tareeke se deta hai.
Common kaam (routing, security, database) ready milte hain, code organized rehta hai aur team ke liye maintain karna aasan hota hai.

interview.q: Laravel kaun sa architectural pattern follow karta hai?
interview.a: MVC (Model-View-Controller) ka flexible version. Detail Module 03 mein.

interview.q: Laravel ko `public` folder se hi serve kyun karte hain?
interview.a: Taaki `.env`, `app`, `vendor` jaisi private files web se access na ho sakein.

interview.q: Laravel ke kuch popular packages batao.
interview.a: Sanctum (API auth), Livewire, Inertia, Horizon (queues dashboard), Telescope (debugging), Scout (search), Cashier (billing).

summary: Laravel PHP ka web framework hai, structure aur ready tools ke saath.
Route, controller, model aur view alag-alag roles sambhalte hain.
Sab requests `public/index.php` se andar aati hain.
Laravel 11 legacy hai, 12 mein sirf security fixes, 13 current hai.
Naye project ke liye supported version aur supported PHP chuno.
